pages.title: Ganondorf Holding Sonia's Stolen Secret Stone in the Ancient Royal Palace from Tears of the Kingdom Coloring Page
pages.description: Ganondorf holds Sonia's stolen Secret Stone in the ancient royal palace in this printable coloring page, raising it above his patterned robes and ornate bracelets. Curled energy lines surround the stone, while tassels, a sheathed sword, and paired Hylian banners add detailed sections to the Tears of the Kingdom coloring sheet.

pages.title: Ganondorf Guarding Princess Zelda Inside a Floating Crystal in His Castle Tower Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Ganondorf guarding Princess Zelda inside a floating crystal in his castle tower, standing with folded arms as Link approaches below. Faceted crystal panels surround Zelda's clasped hands and long gown, while Ganondorf's decorated armor, Link's shield, stone columns, and flaming braziers add detailed sections.

pages.title: Zelda Ganondorf in Faron Woods Coloring Page
pages.description: Ganondorf stands in Faron Woods in this printable coloring page, wearing layered armor and a long cape with a sheathed sword hanging at his side. Moss drapes from branches above exposed roots and rocks, surrounding the stern figure on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Ganondorf in Korok Forest Coloring Page
pages.description: Ganondorf faces forward in Korok Forest in this printable coloring page, with clenched fists, broad shoulder armor, and a jeweled ornament across his forehead above stern eyes. Oversized mushrooms and a small leaf-faced woodland figure appear beside twisting trees on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Ganondorf in Ancient Mine Coloring Page
pages.description: Ganondorf appears in an ancient mine in this printable coloring page, shown in an armored portrait with a jeweled crown and a boar emblem on one shoulder. Mine rails, wooden supports, a pickaxe, shovel, and loose rocks establish the setting on this The Legend of Zelda coloring sheet.

pages.title: Zelda Ganondorf in Castle Town Coloring Page
pages.description: Ganondorf stands beneath a stone arch in Castle Town in this printable coloring page, wearing ornate armor with geometric jewels and a cape behind his shoulders. Timbered rooftops, a tree, paving stones, and a distant castle silhouette frame this The Legend of Zelda character coloring sheet.
